recognize_zh: 拼圖中六個視野各有一顆大細胞，細胞質豐富淡紫藍、呈條紋狀皺紙樣紋理，小核偏心，四周是體積小得多的造血細胞，形成強烈大小對比，符合 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Multi-panel composite; each panel shows one or two very large histiocytes surrounded by much smaller marrow cells
Abundant lilac to blue-gray cytoplasm with fibrillary, crumpled tissue paper striations
Small, round to oval, eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin
Some cells show scattered fine dark cytoplasmic granules/debris
Background of erythroid and myeloid precursors and red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear, shown as a multi-panel composite, contains numerous large macrophages dwarfing the adjacent hematopoietic cells. These cells have abundant lilac to blue-gray cytoplasm with a fibrillary, wrinkled tissue paper texture and small, eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin. Uniform foamy vacuolation and discrete blue granules are absent. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; correlation with glucocerebrosidase activity and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma or thalassemia are morphologically similar, and are separated by normal glucocerebrosidase activity and the underlying disease.
Niemann-Pick cells show uniformly foamy, bubbly cytoplasm without striations.
Megakaryocytes have a large multilobated nucleus with granular pink cytoplasm rather than a small eccentric nucleus.
